boundary: Design experiments, NOT Ebb product or Windows certification

results.falsifier: Two dates select the older date

observations.scope: Original SQL ordering plus reduced selection; not the Go CLI

results.hypothesis: Latest trim represents all outstanding groups
Historical row count equals surviving copies
results.falsifier: Two rows but one surviving copy

results.hypothesis: Matching package metadata proves identical content

observations.implication: Matching installed versions do not prove exact reconstructibility

observations.limitation: Does not defeat every richer stat fingerprint; rejects this specific shortcut

results.hypothesis: A live hardlink is an independent backup

observations.limitation: Single-component check only, not a full race-resistant path provider

results.falsifier: An open descriptor writes after rename

observations.implication: Quarantine and writer quiescence are separate requirements

results.falsifier: Empty output passes existence but lacks required content

results.hypothesis: Any missing output makes whole replay safe
results.falsifier: Another output contains new live work

observations.limitation: Does not invoke npm; models the caller's gating, preserves the sentinel

results.hypothesis: Exact same-volume retention always saves space

observations.implication: Same-volume exact retention does not guarantee positive net gain

results.hypothesis: One observed run includes all future dependencies

observations.scope: Logical counterexample to trace completeness, not a tracer experiment

results.hypothesis: Durability, obligations and leases suffice within the model
results.falsifier: Reachable state violates custody; mutants must fail

observations.invariant: live or durable; an active reader always has durable content
observations.exclusions: Single content object. Atomic abstract transitions. No torn I/O, filesystem, cryptography, arbitrary writers or multi-host coordination.

results.hypothesis: Machine modes never guide; stale/duplicate acceptance cannot execute

observations.exclusions: Reducer model, not terminal rendering or a crash-durable idempotency implementation

observations.implication: A successful installer must not manufacture application-readiness evidence

round2.hypothesis: Verified backup alone permits later removal of live data
round2.observed: Backup is valid but contains an older generation.
round2.revision: Require a stable capture/removal epoch. Snapshots and hash rechecks alone do not stop subsequent writers. Strict unattended eviction needs enforceable exclusion or an immutable owner; cooperative quiescence is an explicit assumption.

round2.hypothesis: Two copy locations protect against a disk failure
round2.revision: Count independent failure domains separately from logical copies; unknown domain must remain unknown, not be guessed independent.

round2.hypothesis: A batch can be described with one done/not-done flag
round2.observed: Crash after component A leaves B live.
round2.revision: Parent batch records per-component generations and outcomes. Promise resumable partial completion, not filesystem-wide atomicity.

round2.hypothesis: After losing the catalog, self-consistent vault documents prove original authenticity
round2.observed: A replacement manifest and seal can agree with one another.
round2.revision: Distinguish recoverable consistency from continuity of authenticity. Retain an independent trusted checkpoint or explicitly re-establish trust; a key or witness stored only beside the data does not add an independent anchor.

interpretation: R01-R12 and R16-R19 falsify the stated assumptions. R13-R15 support only their stated bounded mechanisms. OBSERVED is not a product pass.
R19_threat_qualification: The logical model assumes an adversary capable of replacing both trusted descriptions, or a compromised provider/key. It does not demonstrate a break of restic authentication or claim that a storage writer without the encryption key can forge authenticated ciphertext.
